title: Randomization Inference for Dynamic Causal Effects in Short Panels with Autoregressive Instruments
abstract: arXiv:2610.19075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I study randomization inference for dynamic causal effects in panels with many units and few periods when treatment is endogenous and an instrument is as good as randomly assigned only through the innovations of a first-order autoregressive assignment mechanism with unknown persistence. The persistence is a nuisance parameter in two senses: it determines which weighted average of heterogeneous causal effects the instrumented local projection estimand measures, and it governs the randomization distribution of any statistic built from the instrument. I propose tests that never estimate it. For each candidate value the innovations are recovered, rerandomized under a group that leaves their joint law invariant, and a randomization p-value is formed; the reported p-value is the supremum over candidate values or over an exact confidence set. Under a sharp null on the path of lag-specific effects the tests have level at most $\alpha$ for every

translated_title: 基于自回归工具变量的短面板动态因果效应随机化推断
translated_abstract: 我研究了在多单位、少时期的面板数据中动态因果效应的随机化推断问题，其中处理变量是内生的，而工具变量仅在“通过一个具有未知持久性的一阶自回归分配机制的新息”这一意义上才可视为随机分配的。该持久性参数在两个意义上是讨厌参数：它决定了工具化的局部投影估计量所测度的是异质性因果效应的哪一种加权平均，同时它支配着由该工具变量构建的任何统计量的随机化分布。我提出了从不估计该参数的检验方法：对于每个候选值，先恢复出新息，在保持其联合分布不变的群下进行重新随机化，并构造随机化p值；最终报告的p值取为在候选值集合上或在精确置信集上的上确界。在滞后特定效应路径的尖锐零假设下，这些检验对每个...的水平至多为 α（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文针对工具变量依赖于一阶自回归分配机制且其持久性参数未知的短面板数据，提出了无需估计该讨厌参数的随机化推断检验方法，通过在候选值或精确置信集上取上确界构造p值，从而对动态因果效应进行有效推断。
en_tdlr: This paper develops randomization inference tests for dynamic causal effects in short panels with autoregressive instruments, where the unknown AR(1) persistence parameter is never estimated; instead, p-values are formed by recovering innovations, rerandomizing them under an invariance group, and taking the supremum over candidate values or an exact confidence set.
